title: Abelian inverse image preserves finite colimits
statement: Let X and Y be schemes [def-pc-scheme] in a common universe and f:X→Y a scheme morphism. Put G = Opens.map f.base, the preimage functor from opens of Y to opens of X, and give both categories their open-cover Grothendieck topologies. Define L = G.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X), the left adjoint to direct image on abelian sheaves. Then L preserves finite colimits: it carries every colimit cocone of a finite diagram of abelian sheaves on Y to a colimit cocone of the image diagram on X. No flatness, separation, compactness, or nonemptiness assumption on the schemes or f is required.

proof.text: Specializes to (Opens.map f.base).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X). Its left adjoint is definitionally invImage f. The cited result supplies preservation of all colimits of the required size; Mathlib then restricts this to finite colimits. The adjunction exists by the left Kan extension and abelian sheafification construction in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Pullback.lean.
